# Third-party assets used by CyberArena

## RobotExpressive.glb
- Model by Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius), https://www.patreon.com/quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Modifications by Don McCurdy (facial morph targets, FBX2GLTF conversion, material cleanup)
- Obtained from the three.js repository, r128: examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive/
- CyberArena re-tints the materials at runtime (dark armor, neon team trim and visor).
